children: Major European equity markets are beginning the week in positive territory, helped by a dip in energy prices and becalmed bond markets.
The main driver of energy prices has been Trump's energy ceasefire with Russia and Ukraine, although details of the deal are light and neither Moscow nor Kyiv immediately confirmed the agreement.
Still, the deal has weighed slightly on crude prices on Monday even as hostilities in the Middle East escalated at the weekend after air strikes on Riyadh International Airport in Saudi Arabia.
For now, European stocks are in a buoyant mood, with the pan-continental STOXX 600
up 0.6%. Breadth is positive, with advancing stocks outnumbering declining stocks by over 3.5 to 1.
Banks (.SX7P) and autos (.SXAP) lead the way higher, while energy stocks (.SXEP) lag.
